new.step1_description: Select whether you're buying or selling a property.
new.type_purchase_desc: Track your property purchase from search to closing.
new.step2_description: Select the type of property you're interested in.
new.step3_description: Add details if you already have a specific property in mind. You can always update this later.

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.empty: No checklist items for this stage

notes.title: Notes & Timeline
notes.empty: No notes yet. Add your first note to start tracking your progress.
notes.add_placeholder: What happened? Add a note to your timeline...

checklist.search.define_requirements_des: List bedrooms, bathrooms, size, amenities, and must-have features.
checklist.search.set_budget_desc: Determine your maximum purchase price and monthly payment capacity.
checklist.search.get_preapproval_desc: Get pre-approved to know your exact budget and show sellers you're serious.
checklist.search.research_neighborhoods_: Explore different areas considering commute, schools, safety, and amenities.
checklist.search.find_agent_desc: Interview and select a trusted agent to help with your search.
checklist.search.create_shortlist_desc: Narrow down to 5-10 properties that meet your criteria.
checklist.search.schedule_viewings_desc: Visit your shortlisted properties in person.
checklist.search.select_property_desc: Choose the property you want to make an offer on.
checklist.analysis.compare_market_prices: Research similar properties to ensure the asking price is fair.
checklist.analysis.calculate_total_costs: Estimate all closing costs, taxes, and fees beyond the purchase price.
checklist.analysis.visit_property_desc: Tour the property to assess condition, layout, neighbors, and surroundings.
checklist.analysis.research_neighborhood: Investigate safety, amenities, future development plans, and community.
checklist.analysis.check_property_histor: Research past sales, price history, and any reported issues.
checklist.analysis.review_hoa_rules_desc: If applicable, review condominium regulations and restrictions.
checklist.offer.determine_offer_price_de: Decide your initial offer based on market analysis and property condition.
checklist.offer.prepare_offer_letter_des: Draft a formal offer with price, conditions, and timeline.
checklist.offer.submit_offer_desc: Present your offer to the seller through your agent.
checklist.offer.negotiate_terms_desc: Respond to counter-offers and negotiate final price and conditions.
checklist.offer.sign_promesa_desc: Sign the preliminary purchase agreement with all agreed terms.
checklist.offer.pay_deposit_desc: Transfer the agreed deposit to secure the property.
checklist.due_diligence.title_search_des: Obtain a certificado de libertad de gravamen from the public registry.
checklist.due_diligence.verify_no_liens_: Confirm no mortgages, embargoes, or legal claims on the property.
checklist.due_diligence.property_apprais: Obtain a professional appraisal for the bank and yourself.
checklist.due_diligence.structural_inspe: Hire an engineer to inspect structural integrity.
checklist.due_diligence.verify_permits_d: Confirm all construction was done with proper permits.
checklist.due_diligence.check_predial_de: Verify property taxes are current with no outstanding balance.
checklist.due_diligence.check_utility_de: Obtain certificates of no debts for water, electricity, and gas.
checklist.due_diligence.check_hoa_debts_: Confirm all condominium fees are paid up to date.
checklist.financing.compare_mortgages_de: Get quotes from multiple banks and compare rates, terms, and conditions.
checklist.financing.gather_documents_des: Prepare income proof, ID, bank statements, and other required documents.
checklist.financing.submit_application_d: Apply formally with your chosen bank.
checklist.financing.bank_appraisal_desc: Coordinate the bank's appraisal of the property.
checklist.financing.receive_approval_des: Get formal written approval from the bank.
checklist.financing.review_loan_terms_de: Carefully review all terms, rates, and conditions of the mortgage.
checklist.financing.sign_mortgage_contra: Sign the final mortgage agreement with the bank.
skip_financing_help: I do not need a mortgage for this purchase; exclude financing items from my progress
checklist.closing.select_notary_desc: Choose a notary public to handle the transaction.
checklist.closing.review_escritura_desc: Carefully review the deed draft prepared by the notary.
checklist.closing.prepare_funds_desc: Ensure all funds are available and ready for transfer.
checklist.closing.final_walkthrough_desc: Visit the property one last time before closing.
checklist.closing.sign_documents_desc: Sign the escritura and all closing documents at the notary.
checklist.closing.pay_closing_costs_desc: Pay all taxes, fees, and closing costs.
checklist.closing.receive_keys_desc: Get the keys and take possession of the property.
checklist.post_closing.register_property: Register the new deed with the public property registry.
checklist.post_closing.transfer_utilitie: Transfer electricity, gas, water, and internet to your name.
checklist.post_closing.update_predial_de: Update property tax records with your information.
checklist.post_closing.update_hoa_desc: Register as new owner with the condo administration for fees and meetings.
checklist.post_closing.get_insurance_des: Purchase homeowner's insurance for your new property.
checklist.post_closing.change_locks_desc: Replace all exterior locks for security.
checklist.post_closing.title_delivery_de: Receive the physical deed documents and become the official owner of the property.
